## What problem are you trying to solve?

The "what" matters less than the "why". Tell us what you were trying to
do when you ran into the gap.

## Proposed solution

If you have one. Otherwise leave blank — we'll figure it out together.

## Alternatives considered

What workarounds have you tried? What did you reject and why?

## Additional context

Screenshots, links to similar features in other tools, etc.

## Are you willing to send a PR?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] Maybe with guidance
- [ ] No, just suggesting
